name: Price with saving
description: The product's price, its usual price struck through when it's on sale.
source:
Component(
  dsl: 1, id: "market/product-price-compare", name: "Price with saving", kind: Kind.section,
  description: "The product's price, its usual price struck through when it's on sale.",
  variants: [Variant(id: "default", label: "Default", build:
    Row(gap: Space.sm, crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center, children: [
      Text(child: formatMoney(options.product.display_price_cents), size: FontSize.xl, weight: FontWeight.bold),
      If(condition: options.product.compare_at_price_cents > options.product.display_price_cents, then: Text(child: formatMoney(options.product.compare_at_price_cents), color: Color.textMuted, decoration: TextDecoration.lineThrough)),
      If(condition: options.product.compare_at_price_cents > options.product.display_price_cents, then: Badge(label: "Sale", tone: Tone.danger))
    ])
  )], options: [DataOption(name: "product", type: Product, required: true)],
)
